_doc: Esther voice cast and per-line direction, read by tools/story/voice.py (see its docstring and docs/esther/VOICE.md). engine 'edge' = Microsoft neural voices via edge-tts (rate/pitch are prosody values); engine 'qwen' = Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice run locally (voice = speaker, instruct = acting note); 'qwen_design' = Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign (design = who speaks, prepended to every note); 'crowd' = members layered in a hall. fx: plain, warm, nasal, offstage. chain: expressive (TTS at -16 LUFS, gentle compressor) unless stated. lines.<id>.<lang>.phrases speaks the line in phrases joined by `gap` seconds of silence. Per line: asrIgnore (non-verbal tokens left out of the error rate), acting (laugh/tantrum/wail measure in the take score), phrases[].instruct / gainDb, pick + pickWhy (hand-chosen take), tail (fade into the distance).

narrator.instruct: 一位温暖的女讲故事人，像妈妈给四到十岁的孩子讲圣经故事，声音亲切、生动、自然，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：

esther.instruct: 一位年轻的王后，温柔、善良、勇敢，像真人在演儿童广播剧，自然不做作，语速正常流畅。这一句：

king.instruct: 一位声音低沉、说话从容的国王，平静时很和蔼，像真人在演儿童广播剧，语速正常。这一句：

haman.instruct: 一个滑稽的大反派，骄傲自大又胆小，像儿童广播剧里的卡通坏蛋，表演夸张，音调起伏很大，鼻音重。这一句：
haman.why: Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice 'dylan' with a comic-villain acting note: one fixed speaker for zh and en (VoiceDesign drifted 119-444 Hz between lines), lively (F0 SD 5.6-8.5 st), 0 % CER on his Chinese lines

herald.design: A big-voiced court herald in an ancient Persian palace: a middle-aged man with a deep, ringing, resonant baritone, announcing to a crowded hall, loud, slow and ceremonial, stretching the last vowel long, a little pompous.
herald.why: off-stage crier: one designed voice in both languages, deep and ringing so it is not mistaken for Haman or the king

crowd.instruct: 很多人一起，一边鞠躬一边齐声喊，有点不情愿，在大殿的另一头。
crowd.why: 8 different local Qwen3-TTS speakers (men and women) say the line, offset 0-150 ms, nudged -1.5..+1.5 semitones and in level, in a 1.2 s hall: a crowd, not one voice

haman.instruct: A comic cartoon villain in a children's radio play: pompous, vain and cowardly, hugely exaggerated acting, big pitch swings. This line:
haman.why: the same Qwen3-TTS speaker 'dylan' as in Chinese, so Haman is one voice in both languages

herald.design: A big-voiced court herald in an ancient Persian palace: a middle-aged man with a deep, ringing, resonant baritone, announcing to a crowded hall, loud, slow and ceremonial, stretching the last vowel long, a little pompous.
herald.why: off-stage crier: one designed voice in both languages, deep and ringing so it is not mistaken for Haman or the king

crowd.instruct: Many people at once, bowing as they call out, a little reluctant, at the far end of a hall.
crowd.why: 8 different local Qwen3-TTS speakers (men and women) say the line, offset 0-150 ms, nudged -1.5..+1.5 semitones and in level, in a 1.2 s hall: a crowd, not one voice

es_01.m: 讲故事的开头，温暖、不急，带一点神秘；说名字前停一下
es_01.d: 画面：睡前，你翻开一本大图画书，孩子靠在你身边。
es_01.m_en: storyteller opening; warm, unhurried, a little mysterious; small pause before the name
es_01.d_en: Picture: bedtime, a big picture book open, the child leaning on you.

phrases.text: in the city of Susa, there lived a very powerful king.

es_02.m: 温柔、带着笑；说到她的名字时放慢
es_02.d: 画面：你在给孩子介绍一位你很喜欢的人。
es_02.m_en: tender, smiling; slow down on her name
es_02.d_en: Picture: you are introducing someone you love.

phrases.text: The king chose a beautiful, kind young woman to be his queen.

es_03a.m: 幕后宫廷传令官：响亮、拖长音、隆重，有点装腔作势
es_03a.d: 画面：你站在大殿门口，对着满屋子的人高声通报。
es_03a.m_en: off-stage court herald: loud and long, ceremonial, a little pompous
es_03a.d_en: Picture: at the doors of a great hall, announcing someone to a crowded room.

phrases.instruct: 宫廷传令官对着大殿高声通报，“驾到”两个字拖得很长很长，最后一个字拉长音、往上扬。

zh.pickWhy: the longest, liveliest call (2.9 s); 驾/假 is whisper's homophone on the held vowel

phrases.instruct: A palace herald announcing to the whole hall, slow and ringing, stretching 'Lord Haaaman' long and high at the end.

es_03b.m: 很多人一起喊，在幕后，一边鞠躬；有点不情愿
es_03b.d: 画面：一群人一边弯腰，一边齐声喊。
es_03b.m_en: many people at once, off-stage, bowing; a little reluctant
es_03b.d_en: Picture: a crowd bowing and calling out together.

es_03.m: 得意得不得了，鼻子朝天，每个字都在享受；最后真的捧腹大笑，笑得太久
es_03.d: 画面：你刚得了第一名，站在台上叉着腰哈哈大笑。
es_03.m_en: hugely pleased with himself, nose in the air, savouring every word; a real belly laugh at the end that goes on a bit too long
es_03.d_en: Picture: you just won first prize and stand on the stage, hands on hips, laughing.

phrases.text: 哼哼！看见没有？人人见了我，都得弯腰！我可是全国第一大官——

phrases.instruct: 放声捧腹大笑：真的笑出声，笑得前仰后合、停不下来，有换气声，不是一个字一个字地念“哈”。

phrases.text: Ho ho! Did you see that? Everyone bows when I walk by! I'm the greatest man in the whole kingdom!

phrases.instruct: Burst into a real, loud belly laugh that goes on too long: actual laughter with breaths, not reading the syllables.

es_04.m: 平静，带一点好笑；末底改的话前停一下
es_04.d: 画面：你在讲一个很有骨气的人，嘴角带着笑。
es_04.m_en: calm, a little amused; a small pause before Mordecai's words
es_04.d_en: Picture: telling about someone with real backbone, a smile at the corner of your mouth.

phrases.text: But one man would not bow.

es_04b.m: 一下子爆炸：尖声、气得说不清话、像小孩撒泼；三个“哼”一个比一个响；好笑，不吓人
es_04b.d: 画面：你的玩具被抢走了，你气得直跺脚。
es_04b.m_en: explodes: shrill, spluttering fury, a tantrum; three stamping 'hmph's, each louder; comic, not scary
es_04b.d_en: Picture: someone grabbed your toy and you stamp your feet in a rage.

phrases.text: 什么？！他竟敢不拜我？！气死我了！

phrases.instruct: 跺着脚，气鼓鼓地重重“哼”一声。
跺着脚，更响地“哼”一声，更生气。
跺着脚，最响、最尖地“哼”一声，气得发抖。

phrases.text: What?! He won't bow to me?! Grrr!

phrases.instruct: Stamp and give one angry, loud 'Hmph!'
Stamp again: a louder, angrier 'Hmph!'
Stamp hardest: the loudest, shrillest 'Hmph!' of all, trembling with rage.

es_05.m: 小声、慢、油滑，对王甜言蜜语；两次鬼鬼祟祟的停顿
es_05.d: 画面：你凑到别人耳边说悄悄话，眼睛还往两边看。
es_05.m_en: sly half-whisper, slow, oily, sugary-sweet to the king; two sneaky pauses
es_05.d_en: Picture: whispering in someone's ear, eyes darting left and right.

es_06.m: 低沉、随便、有点无聊；先“嗯……”想一想
es_06.d: 画面：你懒洋洋地坐在大椅子上，随手把东西递出去。
es_06.m_en: deep, careless, a little bored; a thinking 'hmm' first
es_06.d_en: Picture: slumped in a big chair, handing something over without looking.

phrases.text: very well. Take my ring. Do as you see fit.

es_06b.m: 转向观众，搓着手；先坏坏地偷笑，然后得意洋洋
es_06b.d: 画面：你偷偷拿到了饼干罐，对着自己偷笑。
es_06b.m_en: turns to the audience, rubbing his hands; a wicked little giggle, then gleeful
es_06b.d_en: Picture: you got the cookie jar and giggle to yourself.

phrases.instruct: 搓着手，坏坏地偷笑，肩膀一抖一抖，是真的偷笑声。
Rubbing his hands: a real wicked little giggle, shoulders shaking, not reading the words.

es_07.m: 年长的男人，着急但充满爱；从远处喊来；最后一句放慢
es_07.d: 画面：你站在门外，隔着门对你疼爱的孩子说话。
es_07.m_en: older man, urgent but loving, from a distance; slower on the last sentence
es_07.d_en: Picture: outside a door, speaking through it to someone you love.

phrases.text: 以斯帖，你要去求王救我们！
说不定，你当上王后，就是为了今天！
Esther, you must ask the king to save us!
Maybe this is why you became queen, for a time just like this!

es_08.m: 害怕、小声、犹豫；“可是”前吸一口气
es_08.d: 画面：你很想帮忙，可是心里怕得发抖。
es_08.d_en: Picture: you want to help, but you are shaking inside.

phrases.text: anyone who goes to the king without being called could die...

es_09.m: 深吸一口气，然后稳稳地、勇敢地说；越说越坚定，最后最有力
es_09.d: 画面：你擦干眼泪，站起来，下定决心。
es_09.m_en: a deep breath, then steady and brave; rising resolve, strongest on the last words
es_09.d_en: Picture: you wipe your tears, stand up and decide.

phrases.text: I will go to the king, even if it's dangerous!

es_10.m: 压低声音、紧张、慢；问句悬在那里
es_10.d: 画面：你讲到最紧张的地方，孩子屏住呼吸。
es_10.m_en: hushed, suspenseful, slow; let the question hang
es_10.d_en: Picture: the scariest part of the story; the child holds their breath.

phrases.text: Step by step, Esther climbed the palace stairs...

es_11.m: 先惊讶，然后温暖、大方；声音里带着笑
es_11.d: 画面：你看见心爱的人突然来了，很高兴。
es_11.m_en: surprised, then warm and generous; a smile in the voice
es_11.d_en: Picture: someone you love turns up by surprise and you are glad.

phrases.text: What is it you want? Even half my kingdom, it's yours!

es_12.m: 有礼貌、甜、有点小聪明；轻快
es_12.d: 画面：你笑眯眯地请人来家里吃饭，心里有个计划。
es_12.m_en: polite, sweet, a little clever; light
es_12.d_en: Picture: inviting someone to dinner with a smile, a plan in mind.

phrases.text: My king, will you come to my banquet?

es_12b.m: 高兴得飘起来，蹦蹦跳跳，几乎在唱；“和我”前停一下，然后开心地大笑
es_12b.d: 画面：你收到了最想要的生日派对邀请。
es_12b.m_en: giddy, bouncing with glee, almost singing; a pause before 'and me', then a delighted laugh
es_12b.d_en: Picture: you just got the party invitation you wanted most.

phrases.instruct: 放声捧腹大笑：真的笑出声，笑得前仰后合、停不下来，有换气声，不是一个字一个字地念“哈”。
高兴得飘起来，几乎是唱出来的，得意洋洋。

zh.pickWhy: the take with a real laugh (score 4.3); whisper heard the held 王—— as 王田

phrases.text: The queen's banquet! Only the king...

phrases.instruct: Burst into a real, loud belly laugh that goes on too long: actual laughter with breaths, not reading the syllables.
Giddy, almost singing it, glowing with pride.

en.pickWhy: 7.8 s; take 3 laughs better but drags to 12.8 s

es_12c.m: 若有所思、和蔼、慢；真的在问
es_12c.d: 画面：你在想怎样给好朋友一个惊喜。
es_12c.m_en: thoughtful, kind, slow; a real question
es_12c.d_en: Picture: wondering how to surprise a good friend.

zh.pickWhy: 4.9 s instead of a 7.8 s dragging take; 尊荣/尊容 is whisper's homophone

phrases.text: there is a man I want to honour.
What should I do for him?

es_12d.m: 用手挡着嘴，对观众说悄悄话；得意、开心
es_12d.d: 画面：你偷偷告诉观众一个秘密：那个人就是我！
es_12d.m_en: a stage whisper to the audience behind his hand; smug, delighted
es_12d.d_en: Picture: telling the audience a secret behind your hand: it's me, of course!

es_12e.m: 越说越陶醉、越说越大声；最后一句像传令官一样骄傲地喊出来
es_12e.d: 画面：你在幻想自己穿着王袍、骑着大马游街。
es_12e.m_en: grand, dreamy, carried away, bigger and bigger; the last phrase shouted proudly like a herald
es_12e.d_en: Picture: daydreaming that you ride a great horse through the streets in a royal robe.

phrases.text: 要给他穿上王袍，骑上王的马！
还要有人在前面大声喊：
看哪，这就是王要尊荣的人！
phrases.instruct: 陶醉到了极点，像传令官一样挺胸、拖长音、骄傲地大声喊出来。

phrases.text: Dress him in the royal robe! Sit him on the king's own horse!
"This is the man the king honours!"
phrases.instruct: Carried away completely: shout it proudly like a herald, chest out, stretching the words.

es_12f.m: 满意、温暖、干脆，带着笑；名字说得清清楚楚
es_12f.d: 画面：你觉得这个主意太好了，马上拍板。
es_12f.m_en: pleased, warm, brisk; a smile; the name clear and simple
es_12f.d_en: Picture: you love the idea and decide on the spot.

phrases.text: Now go and do all of that for Mordecai!

es_12g.m: 不敢相信：噎住、结巴，最后在名字上憋出一声尖叫
es_12g.d: 画面：你以为大奖是你的，结果颁给了你最讨厌的人。
es_12g.m_en: can't believe it: choking, stammering, then a strangled squeak on the name
es_12g.d_en: Picture: you were sure the prize was yours, and it goes to the person you like least.

phrases.instruct: 不敢相信，噎住了，结结巴巴，说不出话。
憋了半天，在名字上憋出一声又尖又细的怪叫。

zh.asrIgnore: 哈|哼|哇|啊|嘿|呵|哦|唔|末|莫|摸|墨

phrases.instruct: Can't believe it: choking, stammering, the words stuck in his throat.
Finally a strangled, high squeak on the name.

es_12h.m: 忍着笑；讲故事的人很享受这个反转
es_12h.d: 画面：你在讲一个好笑的结局，自己先忍不住笑了。
es_12h.m_en: trying not to laugh; storyteller relishing the twist
es_12h.d_en: Picture: telling a funny ending and nearly laughing yourself.

phrases.text: So Haman had to lead Mordecai through the city on the king's horse,

es_12i.m: 咬着牙，闷闷不乐，平平的、很不情愿；最后一个“哼”有气无力
es_12i.d: 画面：你被罚去大声夸你最讨厌的人。
es_12i.m_en: through gritted teeth, sulky, flat and grudging; a dying-off 'hmph'
es_12i.d_en: Picture: you are made to praise, out loud, the person you like least.

es_13.m: 发抖但勇敢；说到“我的族人”时声音哽一下
es_13.d: 画面：你鼓起勇气说出一件让你很难过的事。
es_13.m_en: trembling but brave; voice catches on 'my people'
es_13.d_en: Picture: you find the courage to say something that hurts.

es_14.m: 又惊又气，大声但不是吼；短促有力
es_14.d: 画面：你听说有人欺负你最爱的人。
es_14.m_en: shocked and angry, loud but not shouting; short sharp phrases
es_14.d_en: Picture: you hear someone has been hurting the person you love most.

es_15.m: 清楚、坚定；说“哈曼”前停一拍，鼓起勇气
es_15.d: 画面：你伸出手指，指着做坏事的人。
es_15.m_en: clear and firm, a beat of courage before 'Haman'
es_15.d_en: Picture: you point straight at the one who did wrong.

es_16.m: 哭哭啼啼、尖声慌张，又快又喘，快要哭出来；好笑
es_16.d: 画面：你被抓个正着，吓得腿都软了。
es_16.m_en: blubbering, squeaky panic, fast and breathless, close to tears; comic
es_16.d_en: Picture: caught red-handed, your knees turn to jelly.

es_16b.m: 国王下令：响亮、低沉、果断；不是尖叫
es_16b.d: 画面：你一拍椅子扶手，命令卫兵。
es_16b.m_en: a royal command: loud, deep and final; not a scream
es_16b.d_en: Picture: you slap the arm of your chair and command the guards.

es_16c.m: 被拖走时又哭又踢：先长长地嚎“不——要——啊——”，然后气呼呼，最后一声大哭越来越远
es_16c.d: 画面：你被拖去洗澡，一路又哭又叫。
es_16c.m_en: wailing and kicking as he is dragged off; a long howling 'no', then outraged, then a big wail that fades away into the distance
es_16c.d_en: Picture: being dragged off to the bath, howling all the way.

phrases.instruct: 被拖走时拼命挣扎，长长地哭嚎“不——要——”，每个字都拖得很长。
一边踢腿一边气呼呼地嚷，又急又委屈。
放声嚎啕大哭，尖声拖得很长很长，像小孩耍赖大哭。

zh.pickWhy: 8.4 s wail (score 4.1) instead of the 15.3 s runaway take; whisper misheard one wail syllable

phrases.instruct: Being dragged away: a long, howling 'Noooo', stretched out.

phrases.text: Let me go! I'm a very important man! I'm...
phrases.instruct: Kicking and outraged, fast and indignant.
Break into a huge, long, high wailing cry like a toddler's tantrum, held for a long time.

es_17.m: 先松一口气，然后很开心；开心的部分快一点
es_17.d: 画面：故事的危险过去了，你和孩子一起拍手。
es_17.m_en: relief, then bright joy; speed up a little on the happy part
es_17.d_en: Picture: the danger is over; you and the child clap together.

phrases.text: The king had Haman taken away.
Everyone sang and danced for joy!

es_18.m: 温暖的结尾，直接对孩子说；“你也可以哦”带着笑
es_18.d: 画面：你看着孩子的眼睛，轻轻摸摸他的头。
es_18.m_en: warm moral, speaking right to the child; smile on 'You can too'
es_18.d_en: Picture: you look the child in the eyes and stroke their hair.

phrases.text: Esther was scared, but she chose to be brave and to trust God.
